decisions.reason: As a close-to-core multi-variant line that has survived several years, it likely meets at least modest aspiration levels, and the firm's organisational slack supports retaining it.
This consumer-health supplement had a clear launch push and, conditional on still being sold in 2022, likely performs near aspiration strongly enough to justify continuation.
Although initially less prominent than A or B, it fits existing capabilities and is relatively cheap to carry, so management would usually keep it unless results are clearly below aspiration.

The OTC migraine product is more distant from the core and therefore more exposed to review if it underperforms aspiration, but in a large expanding firm a still-marketed therapeutic addition would usually be kept unless the shortfall is persistent.
